basis: Existing homogeneous loss proof in thm:predicate-independence; zero gains are not necessary for its truth patterns.
scope: Independence of calibrated instrumental predicates only; not intrinsic B1-B10 or conjunctive gate independence.
reproduction_python:
from itertools import product
from fractions import Fraction as Q
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
p=next(Path('docs/ai-platform-outputs/repair-plans/ETAPA2_PAPERS_IV_X_BRIDGE_MONOLITH_2026-11-14').glob('check_etapa2_downstream.py'))
g=runpy.run_path(str(p)); raw=g['raw_heads']; patterns=set()
for gains in product([Q(1,64),Q(1)], repeat=6):
    data=[[a*x for x in h] for a,h in zip(gains,raw)]
    assert all(any(x!=y for x in h for y in h) for h in data)
    scores=[g['clip'](2*max(map(abs,h))/max(map(abs,r))) for h,r in zip(data,raw)]
    patterns.add(tuple(s>=Q(1,16) for s in scores))
assert len(patterns)==64
